Guidance & outlook: However, the inflation remained within its targeted range between 2% to 6% and it is expected decline to 5.1% in FY27 with easing supply conditions.

As per reference forecast of IMF in World Economic Outlook (July 2026), Indian economy is expected grow at 6.5 % in 2026 while Monetary Policy Committee of the Reserve Bank of India has projected the growth of 6.7% for Indian economy during FY27 on August 5, 2026.
At the same time, use of finished steel reached 147.7 million ton in FY26, lower than 150.23 million ton in FY25.
Growth & demand: That's why, when the World Steel Association projects 7.4% growth in India's steel demand this year, we understand the scale of opportunity it presents, reinforced by the National Infrastructure Pipeline, PM Gati Shakti, and the Jal Jeevan Mission.
Consolidated revenue increased by 7.28% to `1,124.12 crore, while sales volumes grew 10.19% year- on-year.
Most remarkably, the demand for pipeline tubes exceeding 16” outer diameter surged 37%, driven by major new pipeline projects redirecting global oil and gas flows amid geopolitical disruption.
Margins & costs: This product mix and distribution strategy helped drive revenue growth despite competitive pricing pressures and input cost inflation.
Elevated input costs, fluctuations in raw-material prices and competitive pricing pressures weighed on our margins.

It focuses on (i) operational efficiency to cut costs, (ii) product quality and innovation to create a demand pull and (iii) optimal use of production capacity to minimize risks associated with demand-supply imbalance. ^ Raw Material Price Risk Raw material cost is a major component of operational cost of the Company.
Capex & expansion: Rama Steel Tubes Limited (RSTL) shall acquire a 21.62% stake in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM)-registered Automech Group Holding Limited, jointly with its wholly owned subsidiary, RST International Trading FZE, which shall acquire the remaining 78.38% stake.
RAMA STEEL TUBES LIMITED I ANNUAL REPORT 2025-26 2021-22 2025-26 2022-23 2023-24 2023-24 Khopoli, Maharashtra plant is setup with initial capacity of 36,000 MTPA.
Khopoli plant capacity doubled and export orders worth `30 crore were bagged.
Balance sheet & cash: Each addition addressed an identified market need and leveraged existing manufacturing capabilities.
FINANCIAL DISCIPLINE AND CAPITAL RECYCLING The Company reduced its debt-to-equity ratio to 0.16 by reducing external bank borrowings and increasing equity capital.

DIVIDEND The Board of Directors has considered it prudent not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review, in order to conserve resources and support the Company's future growth requirements.
Risks & challenges: Rama Steel registered a robust y-o-y growth of 10.2% in overall sales volume to 2.15 lakh tons in FY26 while facing domestic margin headwinds.
RISK MANAGEMENT Rama Steel has endeavored to curtail the risk of competition by diversifying into various segments with value-added products.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW STANDALONE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS NOTICE OF AGM STATUTORY REPORTS The Company's EBITDA declined to `169.86 million in FY26 from `290.21 million in FY25, primarily due to an increase in operating expenses of approximately 8.65%, which exerted pressure on operating margins.
